product_metadata.title: Progressive International PKS-200 Prepworks ProKeeper 1.5 Quart Brown Sugar Airtight Storage Container, Clear
features: BROWN SUGAR CONTAINER: Plastic food storage container designed to hold brown sugar and keep it fresh
1.5-QUART CAPACITY: 1.5-quart capacity holds a standard, 2-pound bag of brown sugar
KEEPS SUGAR FRESH: Keep brown sugar fresh for longer with terra cotta disk, just soak with water and drop into the sugar or snap it into the lid
DISHWASHER SAFE: Dishwasher safe with a hinged lid that flips open to fit in your dishwasher
AIR-TIGHT SUGAR STORAGE: Air-tight storage with silicone seal, stainless steel hinges, latching lid, and ABS plastic construction
description: Progressive Brown Sugar Storage Container, Clear

details.Material: ABS, PP, SAN, Silicone, Stainless Steel and Terra Cotta
